feed.title: Lee Group @ UIUC
feed.subtitle: Jong Yeon Lee's research group at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign: quantum many-body physics, quantum information, and quantum error correction.

entry.title: New website
entry.content:
The group website has moved from Google Sites to this page, which is built with Jekyll and the al-folio theme and hosted on GitHub Pages.

The main practical change is that the publications page no longer needs to be edited by hand: a script queries arXiv every night and regenerates the list, so new preprints and journal references appear on their own.

This Notes section is for occasional research notes, lecture notes, and announcements. Posts are plain Markdown files with support for $\LaTeX$ math, for example $\rho \mapsto \mathcal{N}(\rho)$, code blocks, and figures.
entry.summary: the group website has moved here and now updates itself
